title: 3 Psychological Tricks Your Brain Plays on You Daily
script_content: Did you know your brain is hardwired to lie to you when you're stressed? When we face intense pressure, our brains often create a false sense of control called the illusion of agency. This cognitive bias tricks us into believing we can influence random events, leading to irrational decision-making during high-stakes moments. Then there is the Spotlight Effect. We constantly overestimate how much people notice our flaws or social blunders. In reality, everyone else is too focused on their own insecurities to pay attention to yours, yet your brain keeps you in a state of high alert. Finally, your memory is not a video recording. Every time you recall a past event, your brain reconstructs it, often filling in gaps with false details. You aren't remembering the past; you are remembering the last time you thought about it.
